deviations: Fix-mode reconcile against ui.json: import ./CPRCoachUI, named class CPRCoachUI, and onAction: PublicApi<void> match the shipped file. All 6 setters called by CPRCoach.ts (setStepLabel, setInstruction, setCounter, setButton, setHoldProgress, setActiveTab) match their signatures exactly. setVisible exists but is not called. No edits to CPRCoach.ts or CPRCoachPlacement.ts were needed.

Ran the verifier with --icon for all 5 icons (warning, call, back_hand, monitor_heart, check_circle): 0 errors. The orphan-icon check now resolves through CPRCoachUI.ts requireAsset. One warning remains: CPRCoachUI.ts is 503 lines (>400) with no size reason in its header. ui owns that file, so it is left for the ui step.
RecompileTypeScriptTool succeeded with no errors. I did not do a runtime log check because this step makes no scene writes and bootstrap has not attached the scripts yet.
CPRCoachUI requires authored children StepWindow and StepTabBar under its root (ui.json scene contract). bootstrap-ui owns them.

Cross-checked against mesh.json: aabb_cm [55,24,120], grounded, min-Y 0, head -Z, chest_point_local_cm [0,21,-14]. Plan spatial_layout used (0,24,-12). The code uses the mesh value, so the manikin root sits 46 cm ahead (60-14) and the guide sits 0.5 cm above chest y=21.
The guide, heart and uiRoot keep their authored local scale: press, pulse and chestWindowScale multiply it. The old code's setLocalScale(s,s,s) would have shrunk the 22x22 plane to about 1.
Hold is pinch-hold (Interactable onTriggerStart/End/Canceled) OR both palms within handRadius. guideInteractable, buttonAudio and holdAudio are @allowUndefined and null-guarded.
The beat resyncs after a long frame stall instead of firing a burst of catch-up clicks.

wiring_manifest.notes: All numeric @input defaults are literals (bpm 110, pressDepth 4, handRadius 10, swapEvery 120, holdSeconds 1, followDistance 45, manikinDistance 60, chestWindowScale 1.5). instructionText/counterText are optional legacy fallbacks; leave them unwired. CPRCoach sets Manikin, HandsGuide, Heart and CPRCoachUI poses at runtime, so authored transforms are only starting values. Keep HandsGuide's authored 22x22 scale, because the script multiplies it.
